verdict.rationale: Perplexity's documented 'Computer' capability runs in a cloud browser and an isolated Linux sandbox. That is a remote environment Perplexity hosts, not the user's own computer. Nothing in the pack shows the assistant seeing or operating local desktop applications, so this is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can let the assistant see and operate applications on my computer to complete work
